kicker: Fee yaad dilana awkward lagta hai?
title: Fee reminder *rude nahi* lagna chahiye. Ye lagta bhi nahi.
fix_label: Due date se 3 din pehle ye bhejo 👇
message:
Namaste [parent naam] ji, [bachche ka naam] ki [mahina] fees *[date]* tak due hai.
UPI: [UPI id] ya ye link: [link]
Koi dikkat ho to bata dijiye, hum adjust kar lenge. 🙏
why: date pehle se, *payment ka direct tareeka*, aur "adjust kar lenge". Pressure nahi, clarity.
caption:
Fee reminder bhejna awkward lagta hai, isliye log late bhejte hain, aur fees aur late aati hai. 📚

Rule:
1️⃣ Due date se 3 din pehle
2️⃣ Bachche ka naam (copy-paste nahi lagta)
3️⃣ UPI/link usi message mein
4️⃣ "Dikkat ho to bataiye" = respect

Due date ke din dusra, 3 din baad call. Save karo 🔖
